version.changelog: Fix metadata: declare GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY via metadata.openclaw.requires.env and primaryEnv per ClawHub schema (fixes security scan mismatch)

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Google review monitoring helper that fetches review data, stores local state, and drafts reports or responses without hidden posting or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill needs a Google Places API key, outbound Google requests, and local file reads/writes, which are proportionate to review monitoring but should be kept scoped to the intended business data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer, package dependency, startup hook, or automatic scheduler setup was found; the scripts use Python standard library only.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions disclose the Google API key requirement, Google network access, local config/state/report files, web-scraping fallback, and manual approval before any review response is used.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Local state files and optional cron-based monitoring are explicitly described; the artifact does not create cron jobs itself or request elevated privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose fits the artifacts: scripts fetch Google Places/Maps review data, compare local state, and generate reports, while analysis and response drafting are handled as agent workflows rather than hidden code.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be comfortable giving it a Google Places API key and storing business review data on disk. Use the environment variable instead of a credentials file when possible, keep state/report folders private, and only set up cron monitoring if you want recurring checks. Review any drafted public responses yourself before posting.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: The scanner's description mismatch concern is downgraded: individual fetch scripts are narrower, but the full skill includes daily checking, report generation, and agent instructions for analysis and response drafting.
[PE3] expected: The credential access is limited to GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY or a disclosed local credentials/google-places-api-key file for calling the Google Places API; no unrelated credential harvesting was found.
[LP3] expected: Network access, env access, and local writes are expected for this workflow and are described, though a stricter allowlist would improve clarity.
[RA2] expected: State-file persistence supports change tracking and is disclosed; cron is suggested for user setup, not installed automatically by the artifact.
[SQP-3] expected: The scraping fallback hard-codes an English Accept-Language header, which is a minor configurability issue rather than a security or deception concern.
[SQP-2] expected: The skill stores business identifiers, review metadata, and optional reports locally as part of its stated monitoring purpose; users should understand retention and privacy implications.
